messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.33-0 released
messages.body_plain:
A new version of the NMOF package is available from 
http://enricoschumann.net/R/packages/NMOF/index.htm

Thanks to 'Win Builder' (http://win-builder.r-project.org/) there 
is also a Windows binary available.

v0.33-0  (2013-08-22)

  o updates in documentation and vignettes

v0.32-1  (2013-08-14)

  o argument 'offset' in 'ytm' can be a vector (that worked before as
    well, but is now documented)

  o several small updates in documentation


-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://enricoschumann.net
